Identify a cohort unit by MRN and encounter date

Source: R/cohort_unit.R
cohort_unit_id.Rd

A cohort row is one encounter, not one patient: a patient with two operations is two units. cohort_unit_id() joins the medical record number and the encounter date into the single identifier a new_cohort_record() carries as patient_id, so the cohort history works unchanged while its unit becomes the encounter. A cohort built this way uses patient_id_col = "cohort_unit", the column pull_master() adds to the data it returns.

Usage

cohort_unit_id(mrn, encounter_date)

Arguments

mrn

Character. Medical record numbers, none missing or empty, none containing |.

encounter_date

A Date vector the same length as mrn, none missing.

Value

A character vector of unit identifiers, "<mrn>|<YYYY-MM-DD>".

Details

Values are never echoed in an error.

See also

split_cohort_unit(), pull_master(), cohort_query()

Examples

# Synthetic identifiers; no PHI.
cohort_unit_id(c("SYN101", "SYN101"), as.Date(c("2010-03-01", "2015-06-30")))
#> [1] "SYN101|2010-03-01" "SYN101|2015-06-30"
